newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Nov 30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Nov 30.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 596,799 tonnes in the week ended November 30, bringing the crush so far this year to 38.540 million tonnes, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.
This is ahead of the 35.787 million tonnes crushed at the same time last year.
CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 26 of the 1996 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content was 12.44 percent for the week.
Australian sugar cane crush by region for the week ended November 26 as reported by CANEGROWERS in tonnes.
The 1995 crush started on June 13 and ends by December 30.

1995 Summary - Total cane crushed 37.389 million tonnes (Qld 35.295 million, NSW 2.094 million), sugar produced 4.98 million tonnes 94 n.t., (Qld 4.73 million, NSW 244,629), sugar content (CCS) 13.12 percent (Qld 13.22 percent, NSW 11.41 percent).
